You have 20 minutes. The timer starts when you press Start.
At the end, take a screenshot of your score and upload it to the quiz assignment on Google Classroom.

blocks.title: Week 3 Quiz: Clauses and Sentence Structure

questions.q: Which is a clause?
Which is a phrase?
Which is an independent clause?
The girl **who sits next to me** is from Aswan. The bold part is …
I don't know **why he left**. The bold part is …
We'll start **when everyone arrives**. The bold part is …
How many clauses? When the rain stopped, we went out, and the children played.
The cat jumped onto the wall and ran away.
The cat jumped onto the wall, and the dog barked.
When the dog barked, the cat ran away.
When the dog barked, the cat ran away, but the bird stayed.
I think that you are right.
It was raining; we stayed inside.
Which is a correct compound sentence?
c: She studied hard, therefore she passed.

questions.q: Which is a correct complex sentence?
c: She passed, because, she studied hard.
Because she studied hard. She passed.
Because she studied hard she passed.
Because she studied hard, she passed.

questions.q: Which formula is compound-complex?
Which is correct?
c: My uncle who is a pilot, travels a lot.
My uncle, who is a pilot travels a lot.
My uncle, who is a pilot, travels a lot.
My uncle who, is a pilot, travels a lot.
